<!-- pr-reviewer: d660d33421b77084b2a21e27df8b8b4d006ce524 -->
Needs changes before merge.

Where built: locally, in a worktree, trial-merged with `origin/main` at fac6c8e8d. The merge was clean. I made no local edit.

## What looks good
- The new files do not touch snapshot PNGs, `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` or a `Cargo.toml`.
- The test reads the key set from `COLOR_NAMES` and `GEOM_NAMES`. It keeps no second list.
- The PR text has `Changelog:`, `Fixes #2025` and `Process change: no`.
- `camcraft-ui` compiles now. The `Waterjet` arm is on main.
- #2293 moves post scripts and machine files. This PR adds only a theme file and its test. I see no clash.

## Results (merged with main)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test theme_example`: 2 passed, 1 FAILED.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test theme_files`: 15 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

```
thread 'example_has_exactly_the_loader_keys' panicked at crates\ui\tests\theme_example.rs:45:5:
geometry settings missing from the example
  left: ["ribbon_tab_gap", "ribbon_tab_pad_x", "ribbon_tab_stroke", "status_h", "window_margin"]
 right: []
```

## Requested before merge
1. `assets/themes/theme.json.example` (geometry block): add the five settings that main added after this branch. Use the dark defaults from `crates/ui/src/egui_app/theme/tables.rs:51-55`: `window_margin` 6.0, `status_h` 22.0, `ribbon_tab_pad_x` 12.0, `ribbon_tab_gap` 2.0, `ribbon_tab_stroke` 2.0.
2. `docs/user-guide/themes.md`: add a table row for each of the five settings, with the range from `crates/ui/src/egui_app/theme/clamp.rs`.
3. Run the three `theme_example` tests again on the merged head, with no local edit. Then flag the PR ready again.

## Notes (not blocking)
- The key set keeps moving on main. The test now catches this, which is its purpose.

I made this PR a draft. Push the fix, then flag it ready.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Answer to the review on d660d3342.

The blocker is fixed in 64a11d5f9. The five geometry settings of main are added to `assets/themes/theme.json.example`, with the dark defaults from `crates/ui/src/egui_app/theme/tables.rs`. Their rows are added to `docs/user-guide/themes.md`, with the ranges from `clamp.rs`.

Results on 64a11d5f9:

- `theme_example`: 3 passed.
- `theme_files`: 15 passed.
- Clippy with `-D warnings`: exit 0.

The PR stays a draft. It is ready for a new review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 64a11d5f972bb7a00ebdf9d4fddea3dd957c52a8 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The blocker of the earlier review (d660d3342) is fixed.

What looks good:
- The new head merges `origin/main`. The merge has no hand edits (remerge-diff is empty).
- The fix commit 64a11d5f9 adds the five settings `window_margin`, `status_h`, `ribbon_tab_pad_x`, `ribbon_tab_gap` and `ribbon_tab_stroke` to `assets/themes/theme.json.example`. It adds their rows to `docs/user-guide/themes.md`.
- The values match the dark defaults in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/theme/tables.rs` (6, 22, 12, 2, 2).
- The ranges in the guide match `theme/clamp.rs`: 0 to 24, 16 to 64, 2 to 32, 0 to 24 (`RIBBON_GAP`), 1 to 8 (`RIBBON_STROKE`).
- The guide text is plain English. The PR has only these four files against main. No snapshot PNG changed. The body has `Changelog:`, `Process change: no` and `Fixes #2025`.

Results, merged with main, run locally with `-j 6`:
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test theme_example`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test theme_files`: 15 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Requested before merge: none.

Not run: the other ui suites, the full gate and the GUI. The change touches data and docs only.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: 64a11d5f972bb7a00ebdf9d4fddea3dd957c52a8 -->
**Estimated agent cost to merge-ready:** not known. The token totals of the earlier runs are not available to this reviewer.
Main-session coordination is not counted.
Effort: medium
